in_marathi.name: Nirmilan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nirmilan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who makes things clear or pure. Derived from the Sanskrit words 'nir' (pure) and 'milan' (to search, to make clear).

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Pure, Clear
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nirmilan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who makes things clear or pure. Derived from the Sanskrit words 'nir' (pure) and 'milan' (to search, to make clear).
